blocks.translation: Pokémon

blocks.source: プラチナ
blocks.translation: Platinum

blocks.source: 筆者はダイヤモンド・パールに付いては未プレイ。純粋に第４世代のポケモンを初めてプレイした上での感想になる。
blocks.translation: I have not played Diamond or Pearl. This is purely my impression after playing a Generation IV Pokémon game for the first time.

blocks.source: 質量
blocks.translation: Content

blocks.source: 何と言っても過去のシリーズで登場したポケモンを含め、５００体近いポケモンを使用することができるのは嬉しいところ。
blocks.translation: The best part is being able to use nearly 500 Pokémon, including those that appeared in previous games in the series.

blocks.source: 普通にクリアするまでに大体４０時間程度掛かった。少しテンポが悪いところもあったとはいえ、普通の一人用ＲＰＧとしても十分な質量がある。
blocks.translation: It took me about 40 hours to complete the game normally. Although the pacing was a little slow in places, it has enough substance even as a standard single-player RPG.

blocks.source: クリア後のやり込み要素も豊富。他のＲＰＧでは自己満足になりかねないやり込み要素も、このシリーズでは他者との対戦に広げることができるのは強み。今の時代は通信対戦もあるので、筆者の様に友達が少なかったり、そもそも、ポケモンで対戦するような歳じゃないだろうという様な人間でも安心だ。
blocks.translation: There is also plenty of content to tackle after completing the game. In other RPGs, such content can amount to little more than self-satisfaction, but in this series, it can be extended into battles against other players. With online battles available nowadays, even people like me who have few friends—or who are simply too old to battle with Pokémon—can rest easy.

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 「僕は新世界の神になる！」みたいなことを言い出す悪役が登場したりと、若干、ポケモンらしからぬ部分はあれど、悪の組織が伝説のポケモンを巡って……というストーリー展開は第３世代（ルビー・サファイア・エメラルド）と同じ。
blocks.translation: There are some elements that feel slightly un-Pokémon-like, such as a villain who starts saying things like, “I will become the god of a new world!” However, the story development, in which an evil organization pursues legendary Pokémon, is the same as in Generation III (Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald).

blocks.source: マンネリ気味といえば否定できないけれど、奇抜さを期待するようなシリーズではないので問題なし。
blocks.translation: You cannot deny that it feels somewhat formulaic, but this is not a series in which people expect originality, so it is not a problem.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: Systems

blocks.source: 初代の時点でほぼ完成されたシステムだけど、それでも細かい改良が加えられている。
blocks.translation: The system was nearly complete from the very first game, but it has still received various minor improvements.

blocks.source: 今まではタイプ毎に決まっていた物理・特殊といった区分が技毎に変更された点は評価できる。例えば、第３世代のポケモンでは、炎タイプの技ならば、「火炎放射」も「炎のパンチ」も同じ特殊技であったが、今回からは、「火炎放射」は特殊、「炎のパンチ」は物理 というように変更された。（というか、なぜ、第２第３世代の時点でやらなかったの……）
blocks.translation: It is worth noting that the physical and special classifications, which had previously been determined by type, have been changed on a move-by-move basis. For example, in Generation III Pokémon games, both Flamethrower and Fire Punch were special moves if they were Fire-type moves. Starting with this game, however, they were changed so that Flamethrower is special and Fire Punch is physical. (Actually, why didn't they do this in Generations II or III...?)

blocks.source: これによって、以前は使い物にならなかったニューラ（及び進化後のマニューラ）等がまともに使えるようになった。
blocks.translation: As a result, Pokémon such as Sneasel (and its evolved form, Weavile), which were previously practically useless, can now be used effectively.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: 金銀時代に基本的なバランスは完成されている。今回の主な特徴としては、ポケモンが覚えられる技の種類が大きく増加したため、単純なタイプ相性だけで、ポケモン同士の優劣が決まりにくくなった。
blocks.translation: The basic balance was perfected during the Gold and Silver era. One of the main features this time is that, because the variety of moves Pokémon can learn has increased significantly, it has become more difficult to determine which Pokémon is superior based solely on type matchups.

blocks.source: これは敵のポケモンに対しても言えることで、最後のポケモンリーグの相手は豊富な技を駆使してこちらの弱点を突いてくる。そのため、難易度は今までのシリーズと比較して高く感じた。
blocks.translation: This also applies to enemy Pokémon. The opponents in the final Pokémon League use a wide variety of moves to exploit your weaknesses. As a result, the difficulty felt higher compared with previous games in the series.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Usability

blocks.source: ・戦闘開始演出に１０秒もかかる。
blocks.translation: ・The battle-start animation takes 10 seconds.

blocks.source: ・ダンジョン内部のエンカウント率が異常に高い。（１／４程度が適正か？）
blocks.translation: ・The encounter rate inside dungeons is abnormally high. (Would about 1/4 be appropriate?)

blocks.source: 出てくるポケモンは岩やコウモリばかり。
blocks.translation: The Pokémon that appear are almost always rocks and bats.

blocks.source: ・先に進むため、戦闘では不要な秘伝技の習得を強制される。
blocks.translation: ・You are forced to learn field moves that are unnecessary in battle in order to advance.

blocks.source: ・メニューが使い辛い。道具数が増えるとスクロールに時間がかかる。
blocks.translation: ・The menu is difficult to use. As the number of items increases, scrolling takes longer.

blocks.source: などなど、過去のシリーズで散々に指摘されていた不満点が解消されていない。毎回こんな感じなのは、何かのこだわりなんだろうか……。
blocks.translation: And so on—the complaints that were repeatedly pointed out in previous games in the series have not been resolved. Is there some kind of commitment behind making every game like this...?

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: ・ポケモンのシンボルが全種類分存在する。
blocks.translation: ・There is a Pokémon symbol for every species.

blocks.source: ・戦闘開始時などにポケモンがちょっとしたアニメーションをする。
blocks.translation: ・The Pokémon perform brief animations at the start of battles and at other times.

blocks.source: などなど、ドット絵には相変わらずのこだわりよう。何より、肝心のポケモンのデザインも第３世代よりは良くなったんじゃないかと。
blocks.translation: And so on—the attention to detail in the pixel art remains as strong as ever. Above all, I feel that the Pokémon designs themselves are better than those in Generation III.

blocks.source: 戦闘エフェクトはかなり派手で見ごたえある。でも、もう少し短めのほうがありがたいけど。
blocks.translation: The battle effects are quite flashy and impressive. Still, I would appreciate it if they were a little shorter.
